headline: Viceroy Hotels Limited Issues Letter of Offer for Rights Issue
sum: Viceroy Hotels Limited has issued a Letter of Offer for a rights issue of equity shares, as disclosed to the NSE on 19 August 2026. The disclosure indicates the company is raising capital through an offer to existing shareholders at a predetermined ratio.
implication: Rights issues under SEBI (ICDR) Regulations 2018 require strict compliance with pricing, allotment, and listing timelines; the Letter of Offer triggers statutory lock-in periods and underwriting conditions that must be monitored for shareholder approval and stock exchange commencement.
detail: Viceroy Hotels Limited, a hospitality and hotel services company, has formally communicated a Letter of Offer to the NSE regarding a proposed rights issue. The rights issue mechanism allows existing shareholders to subscribe to new equity shares in proportion to their current shareholding, typically at a discounted price to market value. The disclosure filing with the NSE is a mandatory step under SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, signalling the imminent commencement of the offer period. No subscription price, issue size, or allotment date has been disclosed in the available filing.

triggers.note: Rights issue structure requires Letter of Offer with statutory disclosures (risk factors, use of proceeds, pricing rationale, underwriting, lock-in) and compliance with pricing formula or shareholder approval.
Preemptive offer to existing shareholders mandated; Board and shareholder resolutions must precede issuance.
Material event disclosure of commencement and allotment to stock exchange mandatory within prescribed timelines.
